description: Default architecture, no weight assignment (random init, expected ~0% accuracy).
No-LN 11-layer net: attention gathers 10 digits, MLP forms 25 exact digit products into column sums, 9 MLP layers ripple carries via step sums, final MLP selects digit by position.
Same schoolbook ripple-carry circuit, D=130 and per-stage step counts trimmed to the max possible carry.
Carry resolved 2 columns per MLP layer (thresholds at n*10^j on c_k0+10c_k0+1+cy), 5 carry layers instead of 9.
Carry resolved 3 columns per MLP layer (thresholds at n*10^j on c_k0+10c_k0+1+cy), 3 carry layers.
Carry resolved 5 columns per MLP layer (thresholds at n*10^j on c_k0+10c_k0+1+cy), 2 carry layers.
All 9 carries resolved in ONE MLP layer (thresholds at n*10^j on sum_{i<j} c_i 10^i); 3-layer net, float32 precision is the risk (fails).
Same single carry layer with model.double() requested; still fails (cause not isolated; evaluation may not run in float64).
G=5 carry groups (2 carry layers) plus a split readout: 10-unit position-gated digit select, then 30-unit triangle one-hot (was 300 units).
Digit products via binary decomposition of a_i (4 gated units per pair, 100 total instead of 225); a_i passed as 4 bits; D=90. G=5 carries, split readout.
binary_products_d90 but carries rippled one column per layer (G=1, 9 carry layers): depth/params comparison.
binary_products_d90 with carries resolved 3 columns per layer (3 carry layers).
binary_products_d90 (G=5) with attention logit gap reduced to 10 (S=40): tests how sharp the position-selecting heads must be.
binary_products_d90 (G=5) with attention logit gap of 4 (S=16): leaks onto other positions and breaks exact digit reads.
d90 G=5 circuit, S=60, readout via shared step units [s>=v] (18 units, 9 dims); head takes differences STEP_v - STEP_{v+1} so no one-hot slots are stored.
Carry per column in two MLP layers (floor(t/100) steps scaled by 10, then floor((t-100h)/10) steps): 192 carry units instead of 440, 18 carry layers. Step readout, S=60.
two_level_carry with positions encoded as 2-hot (row,col) on a 5x5 grid (10 dims instead of 22); attention/gating match both; D=80.
pos_grid_d80 with the two zero-width hundreds layers (columns 0 and 8) removed: 16 carry layers.
no_empty_layers with a weaker attention scale S=30 (full-match vs half-match logit gap ~10.6): sharpness check for the 2-hot position code (3 errors).
no_empty_layers (S=60) with position gate and step readout fused into one 180-unit layer (one layer fewer, more params).
two-level carry split at 50 instead of 100 (fewer total threshold units: 152 vs 192); unfused readout, S=60.
two-level carry split at 60 (156 threshold units); compare with split 50 (152) and 100 (192).
split50 carry + scratch erasure: product layer zeroes the operand slots and writes column sums into the same dims; token vector only for digits; D=70.
erase_reuse_d70 plus the token one-hot dims are erased after attention and reused as the carry slots; D=60 (DH=6).
erase_reuse_d60 plus readout slots (step values, selected digit) placed in erased operand-bit dims; D=50 (DH=5).
erase_reuse_d50 without the constant-1 dimension: constant query/logit come from the sum of the 5 position-row dims (always 1).
Cleaned final circuit: 4-bit token code feeds the product bits directly, scratch dims reused for carries/readout, D=40, split-50 two-level carries, step readout.
Same clean_d40_bitcode circuit evaluated on 2000 samples with seed 1 as a generalisation check (not a different model); accuracy 2000/2000.
clean_d40 circuit with attention scale S=45: checks the margin above the S=30 failure.
clean_d40 circuit (S=60) with the carry split at 100 instead of 50: more threshold units, shows the effect of the radix choice.
Final: 4-bit token code, binary-gated digit products, D=40 with reused scratch dims, two-level (50/10) step carries, gated step readout; 10 heads, attention only in block 0, no LayerNorm.
